name: @red-cup-engineering/read-node-builtin-usage-service
description: Reads one JavaScript ESM script's source into a NodeBuiltinUsageReading record: every node: import specifier it declares, and every call site of an imported Node built-in with its line, exact form, whether it is awaited, and the node-builtin-to-house-hand mapping id it matches, or null when no exact mapping is known yet — a pure AST reading with no filesystem access.
